description: This PHP class 'Parser' in the namespace 'Goteo\Util\Origins' handles parsing and sanitizing referrer and user agent information from HTTP requests, utilizing external libraries for referer parsing and user agent detection.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing user agent and referer information from HTTP requests, including sanitization and internal/external referer categorization.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input text by replacing special characters and removing unsupported UTF8 characters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Parser with an HTTP request, optional host, and subdomains.

methods.name: getUA
methods.description: Extracts user agent information from the request headers.

methods.name: getReferer
methods.description: Extracts and categorizes the referer information from the request, including internal/external and campaign/email distinctions.
